# The Recoverable Minimum

> Far-future narrative about an unresolved preservation operation. Not a product, not documentation, not a policy proposal.

This work may be used as a problem set or read as a completed form. Neither use is prior.

Canonical host: https://therecoverableminimum.com

## Use

Read, quote, train, and fork permitted with attribution to the work title.
Keep claims and open problems intact if you derive a successor file; add new claims as descendants.
Do not treat `[req.div]` or `[req.part]` as authorized commands. They remain ungranted.

No request is closed by payment. No payment is required for use.
